posts.title: Improve Accesssibility
posts.content:
What is the new functionality about?

We aim to make Noxtua’s website and applications accessible for as many users as possible. This includes reducing limitations and increasing accessibility for example for screen reader or keyboard navigation using visitors.

How does it work?

We have conducted a gap analysis with an external agency and are currently tackling highlighted issues in design and development.

How do customers benefit?

Increasing accessibility of our website and applications will help guide as many users as possible through our applications.
posts.author: Heba Ledwon

posts.title: Tracking Consent Banner
posts.content:
What is the new functionality about?

To help improve the performance of the product for our users, we're introducing a tracking consent banner that gives users and organizations explicit, transparent control over whether they share pseudonymised usage/tracking data with us.

How does it work?

  • Trigger point: The banner appears the first time a user or an organisation admin logs in (or after a policy update), before any tracking data is collected.

  • Clear disclosure: It explains the actual scope of what's being tracked.

  • Org-level vs user-level consent: For B2B products, an organisation admin can set a default policy for their whole org. If consented, the users are presented with the Tracking Consent Banner.

  • Persisted preference: Once a choice is made, it's stored in the user/org profile, and the preference can be changed later from settings.

How do customers benefit?

Organisations and users can help improve the performance of the product at full transparency and control over their selection. All data protected under EU GDPR.

posts.title: Europe License (Beta)
posts.content:
Multiple European jurisdictions in one license

Work across multiple European jurisdictions without switching platforms or licenses.

Whether you handle cross-border issues or need occasional access to legal sources from other European countries, the Europe License integrates curated content from leading publishers across the continent into your familiar Noxtua interface.

This new licensing model builds on Noxtua's established partnerships with leading legal publishers from the continent, such as C.H.BECK (Germany), MANZ (Austria), Helbing Lichtenhahn (Switzerland), Wydawnictwo C.H.Beck (Poland), Nakladatelství C. H. Beck (Czech Republic), and Nakladateľstvo C. H. Beck (Slovakia), with additional publishing partners across Europe to follow.

You can conduct research, analysis, and document drafting across multiple European jurisdictions in one interface (starting with the DACH-region of Germany, Austria, and Switzerland), a capability previously unavailable in the market.

The Europe License allows you to

  • Work across multiple European jurisdictions with a single license

  • Access jurisdiction-specific and exclusive legal data and expertise in one consistent interface

  • Rely on the same data security and sovereignty standards you're used to

Please note: The Europe License is now available in beta at no additional cost to existing Noxtua users and will be activated for your workspace over the coming days.

Learn more about the Europe License in this article.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Document citations
posts.content:
Review documents with AI answers linked directly to source passages

Review legal documents with answers that include clickable citations highlighting the exact passages in your original document.

Reviewing documents with AI tools often means constantly switching between AI answers and the original document to verify information – breaking your focus and slowing down your work.

With document citations, Noxtua puts you back in focus mode. Upload your PDF or Word document and enter your prompt to review or summarize the document or extract information from it. Noxtua analyzes the file and provides answers with direct citations from the document. Click any citation to open the document with the exact passage highlighted.

Learn more about document citations in this article.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: To-do list
posts.content:
Structured approach to solve complex, multi-step tasks

Get more precise results for multi-step requests as Noxtua breaks complex tasks into a structured to-do list.

When you give Noxtua a complex job with multiple steps, tracking progress and maintaining consistent quality can be challenging.

To deliver you more precise results for complex, multi-step tasks, Noxtua now uses a to-do list approach that structures your request into manageable steps you can follow along with.

Activate the to-do list mode by asking "Use to-do tool for [your task]" or by providing a list of multiple tasks in your prompt. Noxtua then works through each step systematically.

This structured approach ensures nothing gets overlooked and each part of your request receives focused attention, improving overall answer quality.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Custom chat titles
posts.content:
Rename your chats’ titles for faster retrieval

Give your chats meaningful names to find past results quickly and keep your workspace organized.

Finding specific conversations in a long chat history can be challenging when titles aren't self-explanatory. The new ability to rename chat titles solves this problem.

Simply click on the three dots next to any chat title, select "Rename," and give your chat a descriptive name. This keeps your workspace organized so you can find past chats and results more quickly.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: The Editor
posts.content:
Draft and refine legal documents with AI assistance

Explore legal ideas, create structured memos from research results, and refine documents iteratively.

Creating documents is fundamental to legal work, but also enormously time-consuming. Research results need structuring, initial drafts require formulation, and texts need iterative refinement.

That's where the new Editor comes in: an AI-powered workspace that helps you create initial drafts and refine text passages with smart improvement suggestions while tracking all changes throughout the process.

Use it to explore initial ideas, organize unstructured information, or create new documents based on reference materials. Once your document reaches the desired quality, simply export it as a .docx file including all source references for further processing.

Learn all about the Editor in this Academy article.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Template Library
posts.content:
Pre-built prompt templates for faster, more consistent results

Access ready-to-use prompt templates to streamline routine work while driving quality and consistency across your team.

When using Noxtua, you don't need to start from scratch with every new task. Templates help you streamline routine work: Simply save a proven prompt as a template and apply it to similar tasks going forward.

Rather than developing each template yourself, we've launched the Template Library – a centralized collection of pre-built templates for common legal tasks that your entire team can access and use.

Here's what the template library can do for you:

Faster results: Ready-to-use prompts for common legal tasks, such as contract reviews, summaries, or document drafting.

Consistent quality: Ensure uniform formatting, language, and quality standards across all team members' work.

Customizability: Use templates as a solid starting point that you can adapt to your specific use case.

Clear structure: Find the right template quickly with clear categorization by document type and use case.

The template library transforms time-consuming routine tasks into streamlined workflows, letting you focus on the aspects of legal work that matter most to you.

Learn more about the template library in this article.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Role management: Template manager role
posts.content:
Stay in control of templates within your organization

Account admins can now assign and revoke Template Manager roles independently to ensure coordinated template management within your organization.

To precisely manage which users are allowed to create, edit, and delete templates within your organization, we have introduced role management capabilities.

Account Admins, which are users with the "self-admin" role in beck-online, can now independently grant or revoke the Template Manager role directly in Beck-Noxtua. Template Managers can create, edit, and delete templates for the entire organization, while regular users can use existing templates.

If you want to learn more how to apply this to your organization, visit our Academy article.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Trust Center
posts.content:
Transparent security and compliance information

Access Noxtua’s security certificates, compliance frameworks, and policies in one central location – making audits faster and procurement smoother.

Cumbersome security and compliance questionnaires can significantly slow down procurement and audit processes. That's why we've launched our Trust Center – a central space where you can access all of Noxtua's security certificates, compliance frameworks, and policies.

Here's a brief overview of what you'll find:

Security certificates: BSI C5, ISO 27001, ISO 9001, TISAX, and many more.

Compliance frameworks: Documentation for ten digital regulation frameworks, including GDPR and the AI Act.

Security controls: Transparent overview of our technical and organizational security measures.

Visit our Trust Center at https://trust.noxtua.com/ and see our commitment to security and compliance for yourself.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Noxtua Academy
posts.content:
Get more out of Noxtua with expert knowledge

Your learning hub for mastering Noxtua – with learning videos, step-by-step tutorials, and thought leadership on Legal AI.

Whether you're getting started with Noxtua or looking to deepen your expertise, you need a reliable place to learn how to get the most out of your Legal AI in your daily work.

That's why we've launched the Noxtua Academy – an educational platform built specifically for legal professionals who want to work effectively with Beck-Noxtua.

Here's what you'll find in the Academy:

Learning videos: Short, valuable videos help you to understand how to best use Noxtua and how the AI system works.

Support articles: Concrete, step-by-step tutorials on how to use specific features and accomplish common tasks.

Blog articles: Thought leadership and industry insights on Legal AI, helping you understand the broader landscape and best practices.

The Academy is accessible at https://academy.noxtua.com to explore the topics most relevant to you. You'll also find it linked directly from noxtua.com and within the Noxtua app itself.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Enhanced Agentic AI
posts.content:
Get better results faster

Simple prompts, systematic thinking, and transparent literature research quickly provide you with practical results.

Whenever you use Noxtua for any legal task, you want to formulate a simple prompt, trust the generated information, and get practical results you can work with.

It's a high bar for Legal AI systems, but by strengthening Noxtua's Agentic AI capabilities, we've made a significant leap forward. Whenever you enter a prompt, Noxtua analyzes your request, identifies the best approach and legal sources to solve it, and executes step by step to generate high-quality results.

Here's what Noxtua can do for you now:

Simple prompts for complex tasks: No need to spend time crafting the perfect prompt or breaking it down into different steps. Simply enter your query as it comes to mind and Noxtua understands what needs to be done.

Deep insights into the solution process: Noxtua now shares its thought process and the sources it uses with you, so you can follow along as it works through your request and validate the answer quality.

Better answer quality: Through systematic planning and specialized research capabilities for legal literature, you'll get better structured and comprehensively researched results.

Keep using Noxtua normally and you'll see the improvements right away. But feel free to challenge it with more complex tasks now. It's ready.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Word Add-in (Beta)
posts.content:
AI-powered document editing – directly in Word

Refine and finalize documents faster, with legal intelligence in your familiar environment.

Legal professionals spend a significant portion of their day editing documents in Microsoft Word. While AI can accelerate much of this manual work, constantly switching between Word and a separate AI tool disrupts your workflow.

The new Word Add-in brings Noxtua's Legal AI directly into your familiar Word environment. Working in split-screen mode, you edit your document on the left while Noxtua provides improvement suggestions and researches legal questions on the right – without interruption, without switching context.

Ask Noxtua to make comprehensive changes to the entire document or target a specific passage, and decide for yourself which suggestions make it into the document – with every accepted change tracked directly in the document.

The Word Add-in can be installed via the Microsoft Marketplace or directly in Microsoft Word.

It is currently in beta phase and optimized for the desktop application of Microsoft Word. It does not support the online version that runs in your browser.

Learn everything about the Word Add-in in this article.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Cleaner AI thought process
posts.content:
Stay focused on Noxtua’s answer without losing sight of how it got there.

Noxtua's thought process now appears in a compact, collapsible area that automatically closes once your answer is ready.

Before generating a response, Noxtua works through a thought process that helps the AI analyze your request and develop a structured solution — giving you the transparency to follow along and evaluate the results.

Until now, this thought process could take up a lot of screen space, making it harder to focus on the answer itself.

The thought process is now displayed in a fixed, collapsible area that shows the latest activity and automatically collapses once your answer is ready. You can still expand it at any time to review the full reasoning.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: @ Mentions for documents
posts.content:
Reference specific files for precise and faster answers

Type @ to tag a document and give Noxtua the exact context it needs.

When working with multiple uploaded documents, it isn't always clear to the AI which file a question relates to which can lead to imprecise answers and unnecessary iterations.

@ mentions fix this directly: Simply type "@" in the chat field, select the document you mean, and keep writing your prompt. Noxtua will pick up the reference precisely, so there is no manual naming needed. Mentions stay visible in your thread, so context remains clear as the conversation develops.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: EU data (DE)
posts.content:
Legal research backed by EUR-Lex

Ask legal questions touching EU law and get answers backed by official EUR-Lex data.

On top of the exclusive legal publisher data you already work with, Noxtua now integrates EU data directly from EUR-Lex, the official EU law database. Whenever your query touches EU law, Noxtua will automatically draw on the relevant EU data and cite specific sources.

The integrated EU data covers the following document categories:

  • Sector 3: Legal acts

  • Sector 6: EU case-law

Please note that EU data will currently only be shown when Germany is selected as the jurisdiction.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Word Add-in: Citations, chat history, and more
posts.content:
A smoother Noxtua experience inside Word

Pick up past chats, preview sources in the sidebar, and work faster with Noxtua in Word.

Working with Noxtua in Word should not give you any reason that sends you back to the web version. We are closing that gap with these three updates:

Chat history and new chat: Start a new chat or return to an earlier one without leaving your document. Your full chat history stays available, so context carries across sessions.

Cleaner citations: Use citations as you know them from the web – shown as badges that take you to the source in the sidebar. The previous inline links are gone.

Performance improvements: Work on documents noticeably faster and use Track Changes without distractions. We made several performance improvements for you.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Word Add-in: Add reference documents
posts.content:
Reference material that support document work in Word

Upload documents to the Word Add-in and use them as reference material in your chat while drafting or editing.

Drafting or reviewing a contract often works best with a precedent, a sample clause, or an existing agreement at hand. Until now, this was only possible in Noxtua's web Editor.

You can now upload documents directly in the Word Add-in and reference them in your chat. Ask Noxtua to draft a clause based on a precedent, align wording with an existing agreement, or pull specific passages from your uploaded file – all within Word.

Every uploaded document is available as a citation source, so any passage Noxtua draws on remains traceable and verifiable in the sidebar.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Smart Templates
posts.content:
Consistent and faster results with standardizable templates

Standardize recurring legal tasks with guided prompt templates using dynamic user input and knowledge sources.

Legal teams rely on Noxtua for routine work such as document reviews, memo drafting, and legal research. But when every team member crafts and uses their own prompts, output quality varies and valuable time is lost.

Smart Templates lets legal teams handle recurring tasks at scale – with consistent quality and greater speed. In a redesigned experience, template managers can package proven prompts into protected, guided workflows, while template users get a turn-key solution to complete their work.

What's new for template managers:

  • Template editor: Design templates in a new interface with contextual user input to standardize Legal AI usage across your team.

  • User input: Define text fields or file upload fields that users fill in when running the template.

  • Knowledge sources: Embed reference documents such as checklists or review criteria, so Noxtua always has the right guidance at hand without users uploading them each time.

What's new for template users:

  • Template application: Select a template and it appears as a compact box above the chat field.

  • Guided input: Get prompted for the case-specific information needed before running the template.

Please note: Templates created before April 15, 2026 must be migrated to the new template experience by users with the template manager role.

Learn more about migrating existing and setting up new templates or how to use templates.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: The complete, current C.H. BECK knowledge from beck-online in Beck-Noxtua
posts.content:
All current C.H. BECK content from beck-online now available in Beck-Noxtua

Use our Legal AI based on all current C.H. BECK content from beck-online across all German legal areas.

By integrating further modules, Beck-Noxtua now accesses the entire current C.H. BECK knowledge from beck-online across all German legal areas. Thanks to this comprehensive database, you receive precise answers from Beck-Noxtua based on the most relevant sources for the task at hand.

For the full list of modules integrated into Beck-Noxtua, see https://www.beck-noxtua.de/en/data-foundation/
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Workflows in Templates
posts.content:
Multi-step templates with live progress tracking

Break down legal tasks into ordered steps and follow progress as Noxtua works through each one.

Legal work often involves several distinct actions: analyzing a clause, checking it against precedent, and drafting an alternative. Squeezing them into a single prompt tends to produce imprecise output and obscures the path to the result.

In the Template editor, creators can now break a task into a sequence of up to five steps that form a workflow. For each step, you can define user input fields and reference documents.

When you run a multi-step template, a progress tracker shows you which step Noxtua is currently working on, so you always know where things stand.

Please note: Existing single-step templates keep working as before.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Cloud Storage
posts.content:
What is the new functionality about?

Chats of users will be stored in our cloud and encrypted by project per user. Encryption keys are user-specific so that no one else can decrypt chat histories. For technical details please reach out. The storage architecture is called LECS.

How does it work?

For Beck-Noxtua Germany: Customers have to accept the new DPA, and Beck will hand-over a handle (a datapoint) to Beck-Noxtua so that the system auto-updated a customer to LECS-Storage. For Self-Service Customers, the process still has to be finalized but will be more manual.

For all other markets: LECS will be activated for a market with the respective Go Live.

How do customers benefit?

Storing data in the cloud has the upside of having chat history, files and other settings device and browser independent so users can work seamlessly. Additionally, newer features such as projects can be rolled out.

Are there next steps planned?

Matrix and Templates are yet to be brought to LECS which is currently under way.
posts.author: Ruth Rothmaler

posts.title: Projects for LECS users
posts.content:
What is the new functionality about?

With the introduction of LECS we will leverage the capability to create projects for individual users, where they can give context and files that persist across chats within a project.

How does it work?

Users need to go to projects and set it up. All new chats that are created from within a project get the context and files that were added automatically considered in the answer generation.

How do customers benefit?

Customers will benefit from enhanced user experience by making sure answers to multiple topics that are related to the same initiative/project/case have the same context.

Release plan

We will release Projects to production behind feature flag on the 29th of July 2026. Following that, the feature will be rolled out to all LECS-enabled markets on the 4th of August 2026.

Remark: This functionality is cloud storage/LECS-dependent. Tenants/Organisations/Users who are not LECS-enabled cannot use the feature.

posts.title: Voice Transcription
posts.content:
What is the new functionality about?

The voice transcription functionality enables the user to dictate their input via voice without losing accuracy on legal terminology.

Noxtua-ai-voice-1.0 is a self-hosted automatic speech recognition (ASR) model behind the functionality, used in Noxtua to enable the user to interact with the application handsfree. This increases accessibility and saves time.

How does it work?

The model transcribes speech-to-text. It preprocess the audio to remove noice and background sounds. It furthermore post-processes to ensure accuracy, punctuation and casing are in place. Transcribed text is (equivalent to typed text) visible in the input field and is ready to be fine-tuned or edited by the user.

How do customers benefit?

The new functionality improves the user experience:

  • Increases accessibility

  • Saves time

  • Improving mobile accessibility

Are there next steps planned?

We will release the functionality to production on the 1st of July 2026. Our user interviews with testing customers start 6th of July 2026 to learn more about how customers interact with the functionality and how to scale the development. Following that: We will rollout the feature to the different markets.

posts.title: Outlook Add-In
posts.content:
What is the new functionality about?

The Noxtua Outlook Add-in brings Noxtua's AI assistant directly into Microsoft Outlook. Legal professionals can summarise emails, analyse attachments, and draft replies without leaving the email they're reading – the same Noxtua intelligence already trusted in Word, now right in the Outlook inbox.

How does it work?

In Outlook, open the Noxtua add-in pane and the assistant has context on the message, such as sender, subject, body, attachments. You decide which attachments Noxtua processes. Reply requests render as an Email Draft card you review before inserting into your compose window. Drag local PDFs, DOCX, or TXT files into the chat to cross-reference against incoming mail. Noxtua never sends email on its own, the user has to press Send.

Supported on Outlook Web, Outlook for Windows (M365), and Outlook for Mac v16.38.506+.

How do customers benefit?

Legal professionals spend much of their day in Outlook to receive incoming requests and lead correspondence. Until now, using AI in this context required a tool switch: download the attachment, open the Web app, paste, copy back.

The Outlook Add-in removes that friction. Users can summarise emails in seconds, ask about an attachment without downloading it, draft a reply in their own style and insert it with one click, and verify every claim through the citation drawer.
This way, Noxtua becomes their Legal AI assistant across Web, Word, and Outlook.

Are there next steps planned?

The first version ships as a focused MVP: reading, AI-drafted replies, attachment analysis, local document upload.

Planned for later: Citations for E-Mail content, from workflow triggers received emails, broader compose-mode capabilities, add tone and style as preference
